source/ and include/ contain the unmodified files from
arm9/source/crypto/ and arm9/include/crypto/ at that revision.
The upstream license is preserved in LICENSE.txt. Individual file headers
identify earlier sources and licenses and must be retained.

DSi Studio's arm9/source/sav.c and arm9/include/sav.h also derive from NTM;
Studio adds allocation, seek, size and write-result checks to the formatter.
The BlocksDS makefiles derive from the upstream CC0 build files.
